d:
Fast-paced. FPV-driven. Pure adrenaline.
From the limestone peaks of Ninh Binh to the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay to the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, Vietnam is a country that never stands still.
Soar above ancient temples, dive into waterfalls, and ride the rails through the heart of Hanoi. With FPV drones, sweeping aerials, and a rhythm that never slows, Let’s Go: Vietnam captures the chaos, the calm, and the in-between moments that make this place unforgettable.
If you want to see how we pulled off one of the wildest sequences, head to to watch how we filmed the Golden Bridge.
